definitions.explanation: The record or status of being present or absent, typically in schools or meetings.

examples.japanese: {出欠|しゅっけつ}の{確認|かくにん}をお{願|ねが}いします。
{会議|かいぎ}への{出欠|しゅっけつ}を{週末|しゅうまつ}までに{連絡|れんらく}してください。
examples.english: Please let us know whether you will attend the meeting by the weekend.

notes:
{出欠|しゅっけつ} combines {出席|しゅっせき} (presence) and {欠席|けっせき} (absence).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {出欠|しゅっけつ}を{取|と}る: to take attendance
- {出欠|しゅっけつ}の{確認|かくにん}: confirmation of attendance
- {出欠|しゅっけつ}を{連絡|れんらく}する: to inform of attendance status
- {出欠|しゅっけつ}{簿|ぼ}: attendance register

USAGE:
Used in schools, meetings, and events. When responding to invitations, this refers to whether someone will attend or not.
